title: Q-ASHBY-anticipation: act on a goal's trend before its limit is crossed
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ashbymap --probe anticipation
**Status:** open

Problem: The goal loop computes each goal's trend (`trend()` in `seed/worker/src/goals.js`) and shows it, but moves a knob only after the limit is crossed. Ashby's journal (index: Anticipation, J.5845, J.6328, J.6347; Prediction as regulation, J.4438; Error, J.4688 and Conant's study J.6832) separates a regulator that acts on the error, which is always one disturbance late, from one that acts on the cause.

Build: Add `export function anticipate(samples, goal, horizon_h)` to `seed/worker/src/ashby.js` (hours until the least-squares trend crosses the limit, or null). In `goalsStep`, a goal that is met and is projected to leave its limit within its knob's `review_h` takes one step of the step-function search with the prediction logged; the review, veto and revert are unchanged. Tests in `seed/worker/test/ashby-loop.test.js`: a falling goal is stepped before it breaches; a flat or rising one is not; a step taken on a projection that did not come true is reverted. Bind the concept `anticipation` in `doctrine/ashby-concepts.json` (status implemented, mechanisms naming the export and the test).

**Prediction:** ashby_gaps <= 3 within 720 h

**Out of scope:** forecasting beyond the least-squares trend the loop already computes; changing any goal's limit; acting on goals with fewer than 6 readings.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ashbymap --probe anticipation` passes when the concept is implemented and every mechanism it names exists (ASHBY-KERNEL-1).
